The Pleiades (M45) - S50 Pro, 70min (60s subs), Bortle 4 These are the famous "Seven Sisters" of our night sky and they carry with them one of the oldest and most fascinating legends in history. According to Greek mythology, they were the daughters of the Titan Atlas and the nymph Pleione. When Zeus condemned Atlas to eternally bear the weight of the heavens upon his shoulders, his daughters were left defenseless. The giant hunter Orion became infatuated with them and began pursuing them relentlessly for seven long years. In despair, the sisters pleaded with the gods for help. Moved by pity, Zeus first transformed them into doves so they could escape capture, and then turned them into stars, setting them within the constellation Taurus. Yet celestial mechanics made this pursuit eternal: upon his death, Orion was also turned into a constellation and placed in the sky right behind the cluster. message: 長野白馬岩岳山頂樂園秋季最精華的打卡設施與絕景視角。除了觀景台外其實從纜車開始就美不勝收，旁邊的鞦韆和樹林也超級出片，但是人也非常多你看到的絕景其實都是排隊排出來的，不過真的超值。 三段染（三段紅葉）奇景：深秋時節的「三段染」自然景觀，每年 10 月下旬至 11 月上旬此時北阿爾卑斯山開始降初雪，山腰紅葉正紅。 1. 頂層（純白）：背景遠方北阿爾卑斯白馬三山（白馬嶽、杓子嶽、白馬鑓之岳）初冬披上的皚皚白雪。 2. 中層（金黃火紅）：中海拔山腰處正值盛期的秋天落葉松與楓紅彩林。 3. 下層（深綠與暗褐）：山谷底部的常綠針葉樹林。 交通全攻略 長野站東口轉乘 Alpico 特急巴士（長野-白馬線） 直達白馬地區。也可以從長野站出發的特急巴士會直接停靠「白馬岩岳高山度假村（白馬岩岳マウンテンリゾート）」。 若搭乘 JR 大糸線抵達「白馬站」，可在車站前轉乘 白馬地區路線接駁巴士約 10–15 分鐘即可抵達岩岳纜車山麓站。於山麓站購買往返纜車票（Noah 纜車，ゴンドラリフト ノア），搭乘約 8 分鐘 即可直達標高 1,289 公尺的山頂平台。

Shenzhen, China 🇨🇳 — A City of Contrasts Shenzhen has been an incredible mix of futuristic city life and natural beauty. From the giant Ferris wheel at Happy Harbor and towering skyscrapers that light up the night, to the stunning waterfront parks, modern architecture, and bustling shopping districts, this city feels like a glimpse into the future. But Shenzhen isn’t just about towers and technology. The rugged coastline at Yangmeikeng, the dramatic cliffs and Mermaid Cave, and the turquoise waters offer a completely different side of China. Add in amazing transportation, innovative technology, and neighborhoods full of energy, and there’s something fascinating around every corner. These are just a few of the pictures I took, and they can only capture a small part of this adventure, but they tell the story of a city that is bold, beautiful, and constantly moving forward. Shenzhen has definitely left an impression on me! 🌆🎡🌊
